messages.subject: RE: geom_bar, facet_grid and grid.arrange
parts:
Dear Jaison,

For p4, you have so many bars stuck up, ….so I would use facet_grid by column, or use “facet_wrap” to create by column and by row multi panels…..you can play with ‘ncol=’ or ‘nrow=’ to find out how many panel you want to put.

 

p2+facet_grid( .~trans, scale="free_y",space="free_y")

or

p2+facet_wrap(~trans,ncol=4)

 

--Kaori

From: ggp...@googlegroups.com [mailto:ggp...@googlegroups.com] On Behalf Of Jaison Jacob
Sent: Friday, April 05, 2013 9:16 AM
To: ggp...@googlegroups.com
Subject: geom_bar, facet_grid and grid.arrange

 

Hello,

Sorry if this a a repost.  I am an R newbie.  I am trying to make some composite plots using ggplot and grid.arrange and am running into problems.  I start with the built in data set mpg and add a column to it.  (see code below)


d=mpg
manufacturers=unique(mpg$

manufacturer); defs=as.data.frame(manufacturers); defs$response=sample(c(1:25),length(manufacturers))
d$response=defs$response[d$manufacturer]
p1=ggplot(d,aes(x=class,y=manufacturer,color=cyl))+geom_point()+theme(legend.position="none")
p1=p1+theme(axis.title.y=element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_blank())
p2=ggplot(d,aes(x=manufacturer,y=response))+geom_bar()+coord_flip()+scale_y_reverse()
gp1=ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p1))
gp2=ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p2))
maxHeight = grid::unit.pmax(gp1$heights[4:5], gp2$heights[4:5])
gp1$heights[4:5]=maxHeight
gp2$heights[4:5]=maxHeight
grid.arrange(gp2,gp1,ncol=2,widths=c(2,4))

This works beautifully.  I am now trying to extend this with faceting.  I create a faceting and the scatter plot using the line below and things looks fine.

p3=p1+facet_grid(trans ~ .,scale="free_y",space="free_y")

I tried extending the faceting to the bar plots using the line below and things do not look as expected.

p4=p2+facet_grid(trans ~ .,scale="free_y",space="free_y")

My final goal is to perform a grid.arrange with p3 and p4 just like I did with p1 and p2.

Am I missing some fundamental ggplot guideline?  Please help.

Thanks
-Jaison

messages.subject: Re: geom_bar, facet_grid and grid.arrange
parts:
Thanks Kaori,

The facet_wrap invoked with the scales option as below pulls out only the relevant manufacturer for each facet. So I am one step closer.  However, unlike the facet_grid command, the facet_wrap does not appear to provide an option for space= free_x.

p2+facet_wrap(~trans,ncol=1,scales="free_x")

Thanks
-Jaison
